notes.title: The Cabin - Episode 7 [ Release ]
notes.content:
After reading a lot of comments and complaints about the game, I've decided to do 2 things:

[list]
[*] First, in terms of story, I'm not going to listen to anybody anymore. I've always had the issue of hearing 1-2 people and thinking that's what everyone wants.
[*] 
[*] Second, I'm reverting the game back to how I want it. If you want to fuck Emi, fuck her, and if you don't, then don't. It's on YOU, not me.
[/list]

I've always said I'll never abandon the game, and that still stands true now, but that doesn't mean I want to delete all platforms and work without funding while I do. I know a lot of you have no stake in the game and are happy either way and I want to appologise to those people. If you like the game, then great, play it; if you don't, then just don't play it; it's a fucking AVN; this shit isn't that deep. It's insane to think that I've actually had death threats over this shit and people threatening to kill themselves. If you fuck Emi, it's on YOU!

I'm going to see what the response is from this, and we'll go from there, but just to clarify, I've added Emi back in as a love interest, and if you don't like it, just don't play. And at this point, I'm just going to start banning people from platforms that don't agree with what I'm doing, so if you speak up and chat shit, I'm not going to take it anymore. If you want to reply in a mature manner with actual criticism, that's fine; just don't try and push your will onto me; it won't work anymore.

tags.feature: I've added Emi back in as a love interest

notes.title: Developement Update - Episode 3 | #3
notes.content:
Hey all.

I just wanted to jump in with a quick progress report for the EP3 rewrite. It turned out to be bigger than I thought, but we're now in the testing phase and have about 80% of the testing done. We literally have one more scene to test, and then it'll be done. The bad news, though, is that I'm an idiot and forgot to render about 50% of that scene, so we have a lot of images missing. But fear not; I'll render those tonight, and then we'll be able to test the rest of it tomorrow.

Also, the final scene we're working on, jeez, it's something else. Let's just say you'll get a lot of replayability with it.

Once we've done with testing, we'll need to add in some achievements for Steam and some audio too.

So not long now, hopefully.

notes.title: Developement Update - Episode 2 | #3
notes.content:
Hey all,

First off, Merry Christmas/Happy Holidays. I hope you all got the socks and deodorant you didn't want ¬.¬

Just wanted to jump on real quick and give an update on episode 2 of the rewrite and also what to expect from episode 3 and 4. ( Pretty sure I've told you guys about episode 3/4 before but I can't remember :P )

So, we originally wanted to get episode 2 out before christmas but sadly that isn't going to happen. The writing is finished but I still have a little more art to do. Now you might be thinking "Art? But this is a rewrite, why is there new art?" Well, it's because we've removed a few scenes and added in a few new ones.

I still have around 16 renders to do ( which I'll get done today ) and 1 scene to render ( which I'll render tonight ) and then all we need to do is check for any missing images/render fixes that might need doing, add sounds/music and add achievements. So I think it's safe to say we'll for sure be done before the new year.

As for episode 3 and 4, like I've said in the past ( or I think I have :P ), episode 3 won't take long at all because we've no plans to add any new major scenes. The only real change that'll be happening that we currently have planned is Apurna will be removed and we'll likely be adding a new date in for Kaydence. And episode 4 was wrote by Wizard++ so that one won't need a rewrite, it'll just be updated with new references to tie in with the new stuff in episodes 1-3.

I can also give you a rough estimate for what episode 2 consists of:

[list]
[*] Around 20,000 words
[*] Around 450 renders.
[/list]

We don't have an accurate count yet as we're still adding little things in and touching areas up but that's a rough idea what to expect.

notes.content:

The rewrite is pretty much done, at least all the old stuff is. A few scenes were removed as they didn't make much sense and kind of took away from the whole POV feel of the game.
